# Locale fixtures

Several of these fixtures are adapted from upstream lokalise/i18n-ally's
`examples/by-features/**` (MIT — see repository root `NOTICE`):

- `flat-json/`, `nested-json/` — adapted from `examples/by-features/flatten-mode/lang/en.json`
- `yaml-project/` — adapted from `examples/by-features/yaml/locales/*.yml`
- `dir-structure/` — adapted from `examples/by-features/dir-locales/locales/**`
- `namespaced/` — adapted from `examples/by-features/path-matcher/locale-namespaces/i18n/**`
- `malformed/` — authored for this repo (not upstream) to exercise the
  Diagnostic path on a parse failure.
